en.topic_summary:
Kelvin Kong has been sworn in as the head of the police Department for Safeguarding National Security, replacing Andrew Kan, who has retired.



Chief Executive John Lee (right) pictured with the new Deputy Commissioner of Police (National Security) Kelvin Kong on Tuesday, September 22, 2026. Photo: GovHK.



Kong, 54, was appointed as Deputy Commissioner of Police (National Security) by Chief Executive John Lee on Tuesday.
